caption: Cover: the red coupe tears up Coastal Avenue at golden hour, three stars lit and an interceptor closing, with traffic, mission banner, minimap, health and speedometer on screen.

name: 2-onfoot.jpg
caption: On foot in Old Palm: a fixer offers the next job while pedestrians, a waiting cab, a hidden package and the full street HUD frame the block.

caption: Five-star chase: police interceptors box in the speeding coupe on the coastal strip while tracers fly and the speedometer hits redline.

caption: Mission in progress: Chief Reyes briefs the Tidewater takedown on the beach, rival targets marked, gunfire in the air and two wanted stars.
